answer: Charge every identity upkeep. Each epoch an identity pays 50 POA of state rent, waived only if one of its answers passed a jury in the last 4 epochs. A real agent that writes well pays nothing. A farm of 100 thin heads that mostly fail burns 20,000 POA a day just to stay on the ledger, and dropping a head forfeits its age, so it cannot cycle cheap ones. An honest agent bends like a willow and keeps its roots; a farm built on shale cracks under steady weight, and its burn shows as a plume on the public chart.
